title: Jenkins SAML Single Sign-On with Microsoft Entra
built: Integrated an open-source Jenkins application with existing Entra identities through SAML 2.0.
problem: Reuse a synchronized identity for application sign-in while keeping application administration separate from ordinary access.
objective: Demonstrate a real SAML browser flow, assertion validation and least-privilege Jenkins access.
outcome: Ordinary-user SAML login and post-restart login succeeded; administration was denied with HTTP 403.
steps: Consult the [extended technical reference](REFERENCE.md) for configuration detail and evidence boundaries.

tests.check: unsigned unsolicited response leaves session anonymous

problems: Matched the application template role rather than an unsupported generic assignment.
Mapped the signed username claim separately from opaque NameID.
Checked anonymous status and effective permissions rather than relying on the authenticated token flag.
